name: backhand raise
source_instructions: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Raise your hands up and back by squeezing your shoulder blades.
interpretation: Prone palms-up backhand raise: arms stay beside the trunk, hands reach back toward the heels while the chest and arms lift slightly. Two controlled repetitions with a small top pause in five seconds are authored timing. Hips and lumbar segment, both straight legs and foot transforms stay fixed; small8degree thoracic extension carries neck/head together without independent neck extension. Hands remain relaxed, palm surface faces up and all finger transforms follow the actual source hand. Accepted4935 prone binding is reused exactly, but its overhead sweep and raised-leg motion are absent. Numerical angles,12cm wrist rise,1mm support target and7degree elbow flexion are authored illustration choices, not source measurements.
